app.name: Telegram Web K
app.one_liner: A GPL v3-licensed progressive web app implementing a full-featured Telegram client based on Webogram.

screens.name: Main Chat Interface
screens.purpose: Display active chats, messages, and enable real-time communication.

screens.name: Settings Panel
screens.purpose: Configure app behavior, sync preferences, and manage drafts.

rust_commands.name: save_draft
rust_commands.purpose: Persist draft message content to local storage with synchronization intent.

rust_commands.name: sync_drafts
rust_commands.purpose: Attempt to synchronize draft messages between web and desktop clients.

mvp_plan: week 1: Build production bundle using node build
week 1: Deploy via Docker using tweb.production profile
week 1: Set up pnpm-based dev environment
acceptance_tests: App must serve correctly at http://localhost:8080 after pnpm start (E-RD-003).
Draft messages entered in web client should persist after reload (E-IS-001).
